SwiftUI (declarative! `@State`!) is the default for new screens; UIKit still needed for deep control (custom collection layouts! precise animation!) (!) — interop via `UIViewRepresentable`/`UIHostingController`; new projects: SwiftUI first.
`.contextMenu { Button('Kongsi') {} }` long-press actions (!) — iOS 16+ `.contextMenu(menuItems:preview:)` with custom preview; `previewAction` legacy; haptic + blur come free (system!).

`AsyncImage(url: URL(...)) { phase in ... }` (!) — phases: empty/success/failure (build placeholders!); no caching built-in (use `Nuke`/`Kingfisher`/`URLCache` for lists!); `LazyVGrid` of images needs cache or flicker.

Constructor injection everywhere (`init(api: ApiProtocol = LiveAPI())!`) (!) — environment for cross-cutting (SwiftUI `.environment(\.api, live!)` via custom EnvironmentKey!); DI containers (`Factory! Needle!`) only for large teams.

`AppIntent` with `@Parameter(title:)` and `perform() async throws -> some IntentResult` (!) — return `.result(dialog:)` for Siri responses; `AppShortcutsProvider` with `\(.applicationName)` phrasing; debug via Shortcuts app directly (no Siri wait!).

instruction: Terangkan `fix universal link browser` secara ringkas.

`PreferenceKey` bubbles data UP the tree (child size -> parent layout!, scroll offsets!) (!) — `.preference()` writes, `.onPreferenceChange` reads; `GeometryReader` in a background for size propagation (the canonical pattern!).

`building for iOS Simulator, but linking in object file built for iOS` (arm64 sim!) (!) — exclude arm64 for simulator in Podfile post_install (!) or update the pod; Rosetta `arch -x86_64` workarounds for stubborn pods (ffi!).

`URLSession.shared.data(for: request)` async (!) — check `(response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode`, decode `Codable`; `URLRequest` headers (`setValue(_:forHTTPHeaderField:)!`); errors: `.notConnectedToInternet` handling.

`PassthroughSubject<T, Never>` (no replay!) vs `CurrentValueSubject` (holds latest!) (!) — `send()` typed events through pipelines (`debounce! combineLatest! removeDuplicates!`); `@Published` in ObservableObject bridges to publishers.

instruction: Give a practical example of `xcode scheme config`.

`FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]` (!) — app container sandbox; `.cachesDirectory` for evictable caches (system cleans when tight!); `isExcludedFromBackup` for re-downloadable files (iCloud backup rules!).

instruction: How would you explain `fix list id crash` to a junior developer?
output: `ForEach` id duplicate crash/all rows update (!) — ids must be unique+stable (UUID() per render = disaster!) (!) — model ids (`Identifiable!`) or index only for static content; diffing misbehavior = same root cause.

Socket drops in background (>30s!) (!) — iOS suspends the app (!) — reconnect on foreground with resume token, queue messages locally; VoIP push (PushKit!) for call-grade wake-ups (strict rules!), else push notifications.

`Sendable` = safe to cross concurrency domains (!) — value types/actors/immutable are auto; classes need `final` + immutable or `@unchecked Sendable` (promise carefully!) (!); Swift 6 strict mode flags violations at compile time (migration pain!).

`Package.swift`/Xcode SPM: `https://github.com/...` pinned by version (`from: '5.0.0'`!) (!) — replaces CocoaPods for most cases; commit `Package.resolved` (!); local packages (`./Modules/UI!`) for modular apps.

`Could not resolve package` (!) — network/proxy (corporate MITM!), version range too narrow (conflict with another package!), `Package.resolved` stale (`File > Packages > Reset Package Caches`!) — pin exact versions in CI.

`UNMutableNotificationContent` + trigger (`UNTimeIntervalNotificationTrigger`) + `UNUserNotificationCenter.add(request)` (!) — foreground delivery needs `willPresent` delegate (`[.banner, .sound]!`); categories for action buttons (reply!).

`group.com.app.shared` entitlement (Apple ID + Xcode capability!) (!) — share `UserDefaults(suiteName:!)`/files (`containerURL!`) between app/extensions/watch; the glue for widget data + live activity state.
